mentions.name: Latent Space Cultural Concepts Experiment
mentions.description: This project experiments with LLMs to test whether the structure of latent space can be used to identify culturally bound concepts such as "fan death", optimizing runs of the Qwen model on a local GPU to test theories.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been vibe coding with LLMs to see if the structure of latent space could be used to identify culturally bound concepts, like "fan death" and having it optimize runs of Qwen on my local GPU to test theories.
mentions.author: Natsu
